_comment: Intune Expiry Monitoring Platform — Threshold Configuration
_description: Defines health state boundaries. Thresholds are evaluated in order from most severe to least severe.

thresholds.label: Urgent
thresholds.description: Immediate action required. Asset expiry is imminent.

thresholds.label: Critical
thresholds.description: Administrative action required within renewal window.

thresholds.label: Warning
thresholds.description: Plan renewal. Asset approaching expiry window.

thresholds.label: Healthy
thresholds.description: Asset is valid and not approaching expiry.
